name: pain-tagger
based_on: new-jaxity docs/founderos/laya/pain-tagger-v1.json and the #603 results in docs/founderos/603-laya-pain-tagger.md
purpose: Sales Safari pre-filter and pain-log check. Laya scores each post or pain quote; Claude reads only the top of the funnel and does the clustering.
changes_from_v1: is_pain and money_or_workaround keep the v1 wording word for word, so v1 labels and v2 labels train the same questions.

Checkpoint by language. On English text is_pain runs on the english checkpoint (AUC 0.78 vs 0.53 on multilingual). money_or_workaround stays on multilingual for every language (AUC 0.84 vs 0.67 on english).

pain_category is no longer fixed. v1's seven categories described AI coding tools, one founder's watering hole, and scored at the majority-class baseline. The categories are now the founder's own job clusters, filled in at run time, and the answer is advisory.
intensity is kept but advisory: in #603 it answered 1 on 21 of 24 pain posts, which is majority-class behaviour.
Long text is chunked to fit the checkpoint's window and aggregated, never truncated.

is_pain.instructions: Does the author describe a problem, frustration or struggle that they personally have (not a general opinion, a product announcement, or advice to others)?

money_or_workaround.instructions: Does the author mention paying for something, switching or cancelling a tool, or a workaround or hack they built themselves?

intensity.instructions: How intense is the author's pain or frustration?
criteria: severe: angry, desperate, quitting or blocked

pain_category.instructions: Which of these jobs is the author mainly struggling with?
